suggestions: Pre-filter a large table as a subquery
reached_sql:
WITH mv AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT dt.d_year,
           item.i_brand_id AS brand_id,
           item.i_brand AS brand,
           SUM(ss_sales_price) AS sum_agg
    FROM item
    JOIN store_sales ON store_sales.ss_item_sk = item.i_item_sk
    JOIN date_dim dt ON dt.d_date_sk = store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk
    WHERE item.i_manufact_id = 816
      AND dt.d_moy = 11
    GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((dt.d_year, item.i_brand, item.i_brand_id))
)
SELECT d_year, brand_id, brand, sum_agg
FROM mv
ORDER BY d_year, sum_agg DESC, brand_id
LIMIT 100
